metaDescription: Order custom Post It sticky notes flags with your logo. Perfect for offices, events & giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Post It sticky notes flags combine the trusted quality of 3M with your custom branding. Ideal for office supply giveaways, trade show handouts, or internal communications, these notes grab attention every time they are used. Choose from multiple sizes like 4 x 8 or 5 x 7, and add your logo in full color. With 25 sheets per pad, they offer long-lasting visibility for your message.
heroAltText: Custom Post It sticky notes flags with a printed logo, available in various sizes for office branding.
